title: Avian Influenza | Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
snippet:
APHIS cooperates with States, industry, and others to carry out avian influenza prevention and control programs. These programs provide uniform standards (310.07 KB)  to prevent and control H5/H7 avian influenza in flocks of all sizes, including commercial flocks, household flocks, and live bird markets. APHIS coordinates the programs and provides resources to help States implement standards.

#### Emergency Preparedness and Response [...] Avian influenza, or "bird flu," is a contagious viral disease of domestic and wild birds. It's a major threat to the poultry industry, animal health, trade, and the economy worldwide.
